hooks.prompt:
Validate pricing calculation inputs. If the command contains pricing calculations, verify:
1. All numeric values are positive (prices, costs, volumes)
2. Percentages are between -100 and 1000 (reasonable range)
3. Margin percentages are less than 100%
4. No division by zero scenarios

If inputs look valid, respond with: VALID
If inputs have issues, respond with: INVALID: [brief explanation]

Command to validate: $ARGUMENTS

hooks.command: echo '[Pricing Plugin] Calculation completed at $(date)' >> ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/logs/calculations.log 2>/dev/null || true
